subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google's docs present the surface as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source proves stale visible copy, but the proposed string differs from the current official docs and broad renaming could affect provider/config compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to the current Google-docs wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave visible copy unchanged until maintainers decide OpenClaw should follow the new Google branding across provider docs and setup UI.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label but document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex API/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to the current Google-docs wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest inspected git-history signal on the Google provider contract and recent provider onboarding/catalog behavior; BunsDev is also discussion-mentioned for UI/docs wording.
